description: This Java class provides the default implementation of a JavaScript configuration, managing parameters such as maximum script size, execution time, and stack depth, loaded from external configuration using Typesafe Config and custom utility classes.

classes.name: DefaultJavaScriptConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing JavaScriptConfig, encapsulating script size, execution time, and stack depth settings loaded from configuration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method creating an instance from a Config object.

methods.name: getMaxScriptSizeBytes
methods.description: Returns the maximum script size in bytes.

methods.name: getMaxScriptExecutionTime
methods.description: Returns the maximum script execution time as Duration.

methods.name: getMaxScriptStackDepth
methods.description: Returns the maximum script stack depth.
